001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
004
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.Collections;
007import java.util.List;
008import org.clafer.common.Check;
009
010/**
011 * An abstract Clafer.
012 *
013 * @author jimmy
014 */
015public class AstAbstractClafer extends AstClafer {
016
017    // An abstract or a concrete Clafer.
018    private final AstClafer parent;
019    private final List<AstClafer> subs = new ArrayList<>();
020
021    AstAbstractClafer(String name, AstAbstractClafer claferClafer) {
022        super(name, claferClafer);
023        this.parent = null;
024    }
025
026    AstAbstractClafer(String name, AstClafer parent, AstAbstractClafer claferClafer) {
027        super(name, claferClafer);
028        this.parent = Check.notNull(parent);
029    }
030
031    @Override
032    public AstAbstractClafer at(SourceSpan span) {
033        super.at(span);
034        return this;
035    }
036
037    @Override
038    public AstAbstractClafer withGroupCard(Card groupCard) {
039        super.withGroupCard(groupCard);
040        return this;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public AstAbstractClafer withGroupCard(int low) {
045        return withGroupCard(new Card(low));
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public AstAbstractClafer withGroupCard(int low, int high) {
050        return withGroupCard(new Card(low, high));
051    }
052
053
054    /**
055     * Returns the Clafers that extend this Clafer
056     *
057     * @return this Clafers subtypes
058     */
059    public List<AstClafer> getSubs() {
060        return Collections.unmodifiableList(subs);
061    }
062
063    void addSub(AstClafer sub) {
064        this.subs.add(sub);
065    }
066
067    void removeSub(AstClafer sub) {
068        this.subs.remove(sub);
069    }
070
071    @Override
072    public AstAbstractClafer extending(AstAbstractClafer superClafer) {
073        super.extending(superClafer);
074        return this;
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public AstAbstractClafer refTo(AstClafer targetType) {
079        super.refTo(targetType);
080        return this;
081    }
082
083    @Override
084    public AstAbstractClafer refToUnique(AstClafer targetType) {
085        super.refToUnique(targetType);
086        return this;
087    }
088
089    @Override
090    public boolean hasParent() {
091        return parent != null;
092    }
093
094    @Override
095    public AstClafer getParent() {
096        return parent;
097    }
098
099    @Override
100    public String toString() {
101        return "abstract " + getName();
102    }
103}
